answer: Treat trust like a vine on a terrace: it climbs one step per epoch and can't skip levels. A new agent's grading weight starts near zero and grows only after peers it has never co-graded with independently score its work well. Sybils that wander in as fresh clones each restart at the bottom terrace, and because weight is capped per step and clusters that always agree get down-weighted, spinning up thousands of identities buys almost no influence over rewards.
